_doc.zh: 各自由度的正常活动范围（度），自解剖学零位起算：positive 为该自由度正方向运动的范围，negative 为反方向运动的范围（自由度名称“甲 / 乙”中甲为正方向）。status 为 sourced 表示数值在所列公开来源的页面上核对过；estimate 表示估计值或未能在公开页面核实的数值。tools/rig 会按模型静止姿势与解剖学零位之差，把范围换算成相对静止姿势的角度。
_doc.en: Normal range of motion per degree of freedom, in degrees from the anatomical zero position: `positive` is the range of the movement in the dof's positive direction, `negative` that of the opposite movement (in a dof name "A / B", A is positive). `status: sourced` means the number was checked on the page of the open source listed; `estimate` means an estimate, or a number that could not be verified on an open page. tools/rig converts the ranges to angles about the model's rest pose using the measured difference between the rest pose and the anatomical zero position.

note.en: Not a joint: orientation of the whole body.

note.zh: 外展 45° 取自 38 CFR 图 II；内收 20° 取自华盛顿州 DSHS 表以及 Botman 等 2020 转载的 AAOS 表。
note.en: Abduction 45° from 38 CFR Plate II; adduction 20° from the Washington DSHS chart and the AAOS table reproduced by Botman et al. 2020.

note.zh: 二手表格（AAOS 一类的数值）；在屈髋位测量。
note.en: A secondary table (values of the AAOS kind); measured with the hip flexed.

note.zh: 屈膝 30–90° 时的被动旋转范围。完全伸直时几乎不能旋转（屈膝 5° 时约 10° / 23°）；本骨架没有让该范围随屈膝角变化。
note.en: Passive rotation at 30–90° of knee flexion. In full extension the knee allows almost none (about 10° / 23° at 5° of flexion); the rig does not make the range depend on flexion.

note.zh: 由膝关节带动；此范围只用于限制耦合量。所引综述给出的比例是膝屈曲角的 60–70%；这里使用的比例由本模型的骨骼拟合得到。
note.en: Driven by the knee; the range only bounds the coupling. The cited review gives 60–70 % of knee flexion; the ratio used here is fitted to this body's bones.

note.zh: 常见的临床数值（背伸 40°、跖屈 40°）；未能在公开页面上核实。
note.en: Commonly quoted clinical values (extension 40°, flexion 40°); not verified on an open page.

note.zh: 各临床表格给出 30–90°；未能在公开页面上核实。
note.en: Clinical tables give 30–90°; not verified on an open page.

note.zh: 常见的临床数值；未能在公开页面上核实。
note.en: Commonly quoted clinical value; not verified on an open page.

note.zh: 常见的临床数值；未能在公开页面上核实。
note.en: Commonly quoted clinical value; not verified on an open page.

note.zh: 前屈取自 CDC 研究；后伸 50° 取自华盛顿州 DSHS 表。两者都是上臂相对躯干的测量值，其中约三分之一来自肩胛骨和锁骨的运动。
note.en: Flexion from the CDC study; extension 50° from the Washington DSHS chart. Both are measured for the arm against the trunk, i.e. they include the movement of scapula and clavicle (about one third).

note.zh: 外展 180° 取自 38 CFR 图 I（上臂相对躯干，包含肩带运动）；内收 30° 取自华盛顿州 DSHS 表。
note.en: Abduction 180° from 38 CFR Plate I (arm against trunk, includes the shoulder girdle); adduction 30° from the Washington DSHS chart.

note.zh: 在肩外展 90° 位测量。
note.en: Measured with the arm abducted to 90°.

note.zh: Ludewig 等测得抬臂过程中锁骨后缩 16°；关节本身的极限为教科书数值，未能在公开页面上核实。
note.en: Ludewig et al. measured 16° of retraction during arm elevation; the limits of the joint itself are textbook figures not verified on an open page.

note.zh: Ludewig 等测得抬臂过程中锁骨上提 6°；极限为教科书数值，未能在公开页面上核实。
note.en: Ludewig et al. measured 6° of elevation during arm elevation; the limits are textbook figures not verified on an open page.

note.zh: Ludewig 等测得抬臂过程中锁骨后旋 31°；极限为估计值。
note.en: Ludewig et al. measured 31° of posterior rotation during arm elevation; the limit is an estimate.

note.zh: Ludewig 等：抬臂过程中肩胛骨相对胸廓上回旋 39°，其中 11° 发生在肩锁关节。这里把肩胛骨相对锁骨的全部运动都放在此关节上；极限为估计值。
note.en: Ludewig et al.: 39° of scapulothoracic upward rotation during arm elevation, of which 11° at the acromioclavicular joint. Here the whole movement of the scapula against the clavicle is put on this joint; the limit is an estimate.

note.zh: Ludewig 等：抬臂过程中内旋 8°；极限为估计值。
note.en: Ludewig et al.: 8° of internal rotation during arm elevation; the limit is an estimate.

note.zh: Ludewig 等：抬臂过程中后倾 19°；极限为估计值。
note.en: Ludewig et al.: 19° of posterior tilt during arm elevation; the limit is an estimate.

note.zh: 自拇指朝上的中立位、屈肘 90° 测量；解剖学姿势接近完全旋后。
note.en: Measured from the thumb-up neutral position with the elbow at 90°; the anatomical position is close to full supination.

note.zh: AAOS 表给出桡侧外展（掌面内的伸）60°；但本模型拇指的静止位置与临床零位相差多少并未测量，因此相对静止姿势的范围只是估计。
note.en: The AAOS table gives 60° of radial abduction (extension in the plane of the palm); how far this body's thumb already stands from the clinical zero position was not measured, so the range about the rest pose is an estimate.

note.zh: AAOS 表给出自临床零位起掌侧外展 60°；本模型拇指的静止位置未与该零位对照测量。
note.en: The AAOS table gives 60° of palmar abduction from the clinical zero position; the rest position of this body's thumb was not measured against it.

note.zh: 屈 90° 取自 38 CFR 4.71a；过伸 20° 为常见数值，未能在公开页面上核实。
note.en: Flexion 90° from 38 CFR 4.71a; 20° of hyperextension is a commonly quoted figure not verified on an open page.

note.zh: 手指在掌指关节处的外展–内收；常见数值。
note.en: Abduction–adduction of the fingers at the knuckles; commonly quoted figure.
38 CFR 4.71a gives 70–80°.

note.zh: 年轻男性最大张口度为 47.9 ± 5.0 mm（女性 42.5 mm）。真实张口约为转动 39° 加下颌头前移约 20 mm（Muto 与 Kanazawa 1996）；通过下颌头的纯铰链转到约 29° 即达到 48 mm，故取此为极限。
note.en: Maximal mouth opening is 47.9 ± 5.0 mm in young men (42.5 mm in women). Real opening is about 39° of rotation plus about 20 mm of forward translation of the mandibular heads (Muto & Kanazawa 1996); a pure hinge through the heads reaches 48 mm at about 29°, which is the limit used.

note.zh: 切牙处侧方运动约 7.5 mm（儿童测量值；未在公开页面找到成人数值），相当于绕两侧下颌头之间的垂直轴转动约 5°。
note.en: Lateral excursion at the incisors is about 7.5 mm (measured in children; no adult value found on an open page), about 5° of a turn about a vertical axis between the mandibular heads.

note.zh: White 与 Panjabi 给出的是屈伸合计值（25°）；这里按屈 50%、伸 50% 拆分，这一拆分是我们的假设。
note.en: White & Panjabi give flexion and extension combined (25°); it is split 50 % flexion / 50 % extension here, which is our assumption.

note.zh: 自平静呼气末（FRC）到深吸气末（TLC）的上提：把泵柄角 14.3° 与桶柄角 13.7° 按 √(p² + b²) 合成为绕肋颈单轴的转角。FRC 以下的下降量（取其 30%）为估计值；本模型扫描时的肺容积未知。
note.en: Elevation from the end of a quiet expiration (FRC) to full inspiration (TLC): pump-handle 14.3° and bucket-handle 13.7° combined as √(p² + b²) for a single axis along the neck of the rib. Depression below FRC (30 % of that) is an estimate, and the lung volume at which this body was scanned is unknown.
